item.title: Time called on Constitution Hill’s hurdles career – but fans will see him parade at the Cheltenham Festival
item.description: Constitution Hill and Nico de Boinville, pictured on their way to winning the 2023 Champion Hurdle. Constitution Hill has been withdrawn from the Champion Hurdle and will start the “next chapter” of his career. Trainer Nicky Henderson announced the end of the racing star’s jumps career today (25 February), with his future runs expected to be on the Flat. item.title: Everything you need to know about body protector standards – and what’s accepted for your discipline
item.description: Not only are body protectors required by some governing bodies, they must meet a particular standard to be accepted.Body protectors are designed to absorb impact from a fall, a kick or being stepped on by a horse, and certain body protector standards are compulsory for competitions under the rules of governing bodies.
